_comment: VASP registry. Adding an exchange = adding an entry. 'start_url' is only where the TinyFish agent starts; the agent finds the current law-enforcement process itself, so stale hints are corrected at runtime. 'fallback' is what the report shows when the agent fails, and is marked for manual verification.

fallback.process: Submit via the Binance Law Enforcement Request System (official email domain required).
Search the OKX help centre for the law-enforcement request guide.
Use the Coinbase law-enforcement request portal.
Find the law-enforcement section under Kraken legal pages.
Locate the compliance / grievance officer contact on the site.
Locate the law-enforcement / grievance officer contact on the site.
